lightning.about: 2026-10-29 (operator: "I see Goverlord orchestrating like how lightning branches out gravitating to the path of least resistance: the library of value points ... whatever shortest trajectory it takes to grab the best relevant value points ... pull out with the goodies the same way the lightning disappears"; "topic order still matters to GOPOD game * what needs to be revealed first, so whatever value reveals after make better sense * bigger aha moment * I would establish a dynamic topic order valuation list of topic-cluster topics found"): a question branches out over every value point; each pulls by the words it shares with the question (rarer words harder), its topic by its own words (trigger_pull). Two stages: the lightning finds the strong branches - a trigger matched, or a point pulling min_word_pull or more, and only those pulling keep_share or more of the best; then the order decides - the topics found in the game's order, the ones already covered last. The best top_topics are loaded; inside a topic the point asked about first, else the next in order. on false: the word triggers alone.

scripted_snippets.about: Flavour lists: exact lines the code says for a Brobot, word for word, stitched to the LLM's reply (operator 2026-10-05: "scripted snippets to stitch together"; 2026-10-06: "the brobots can each build up a flavoured personality from a list of shared and specific party-brobot responses"). Each entry: when - a topic pack name from gopod_probes/scenario_packs/registry.json, bingo_not_played (a Bingo question while the Bingo-played flag is 0), thanks (a thank-you: chat_hold.thanks_phrases; operator 2026-10-06: "Brobots as GOPOD reps > scripted snippets (CTA's) / remember to GOPOD Yourself / subscribe to newsletter"), reply_mentions (the LLM's reply holds one of words), or any (every reply); chance - 0 to 1, how often a matching entry is used (left out = always; operator 2026-10-06: CTA reminders through the chat, "wanna know more? get CREW'd ... and if you ever feel the urge, just GOPOD Yourself!"); brobot - "Brobot 1" or "Brobot 2" for his own line, left out for both; at - "start" (after the cue word, the default) or "end"; lines - one is picked each time, never the same one twice in a row. Per Brobot, list his own entry before the shared one. The first matching entry wins: at most one start line and one end line per reply. The LLM is not told the lines; if it says one anyway, that copy is dropped. They show in the bubble, are spoken in that Brobot's voice, and are remembered with his reply. when "reminder": the "Hey, that reminds me..." line the value-point list picks (value_points.reminders).

value_points.about: Value-point coverage (operator 2026-10-06: "the brobots keep a list of, has this topic been previously discussed, what value points were revealed and do they remind me of other value points to cover. End goal ... cover all or as many value points in all topics, per interview session"; gopod_value_points.go). A topic pack's numbered lines are its value points (none: the pack is one point). When a topic loads, the LLM gets the pack's other lines and only the next point not yet revealed, then it's ticked off - one list for both Brobots, fresh at each Wire-Pod start (one interview session). All revealed: the topic is covered, and asked again it gets the whole pack. reminders: for each topic, the "Hey, that reminds me..." line that points to it, in the operator's words - after a reply, the scripted_snippets "reminder" entry says the line of the next topic in interview_chapters order that isn't covered yet. At "Thanks Brobots", score_text shows in a Goverlord bubble (score_role), and the list is logged (GOPOD_COVERAGE) and kept with a Record Session. Needs wpr 2. what_else_topic: the pack for "what else can we talk about?" (operator 2026-10-06: "the brobot GOPOD pros know ... refer to the 'topics & value points covered' list") - it gets the titles of the next what_else_count chapters, in interview order, with points not covered yet, and the score so far; it isn't counted in the score.

interview_script.about: The draft performance replay (operator 2026-10-07: "replay a 'draft performance run' to review & edit"; gopod_interview_script.go). A full dry run (harvest_dry_run.sh) writes draft_performance.json - the whole show in order, with the Brobots' own answers; edit an answer's say or cue there. Typing play_words in the Brobots chat plays the newest best-takes draft under drafts_dir (harvest_dry_run.sh best-takes), else the newest dry run's (or draft, when set) through the robots: each question goes in as a typed line, the reporter reads it, and the Brobot says the draft's answer word for word instead of asking the LLM - chapter titles, pictures, highlight, speech, Record Session and the sign-off ending all as live. gap_seconds between answers. stop_words stops after the line being said. 2026-10-09 (operator: "Ensure draft run is composed in a human friendly format, I can replay, and I can make edits"): draft_script.md beside a draft_performance.json is what plays when it is there - a plain script, one line per spoken line (gopod_draft_script.go). 2026-10-09 (operator: "all are runs ... 'start [run-name]' ... update to 'start interview' (& stop run)"): play_words is "start interview"; "stop run" (song_stop.stop_words) stops it, so stop_words is empty.
interview_script.song_id_about: 2026-10-10: the song is found by its song_id (its knobs.json), wherever its folder is (gopod_song_folders.go; operator: "even shuffling (song) folders without notice should be easy to remap"). Before: song_dir. 2026-10-09 (operator: "can I get a standardized format now for interview and bingo? ... I'm familiar with bingo test song folder set up"): the interview's song folder, relative to the overlay's chipper folder - story.md (the words) and knobs.json / zKnobs.json (who says each line, cues, moves), set up like the Bingo test (gopod_interview_song.go). When set, start interview plays it; empty: the newest draft under drafts_dir, as before.
interview_script.bookends_about: 2026-10-08 (the record cut's script): with bookends_from_draft on, the reporters' opening (at Wire-Pod start) and closing (after Thanks Brobots) come from the newest draft's own opening/closing lines when it has them, instead of reporter_voices.opening/closing. A draft question's before lines by a reporter are said before it; its read_by names its reporter; an answer by the other Brobot is his handoff, said after the answer.
